mission_05: Use np.linalg.svd(A) to compute the SVD decomposition.
np.linalg.svd returns U, s (1D array), and Vt (V transposed).
Convert s to a diagonal matrix with np.diag(s) for reconstruction.
The rank equals the number of non-zero singular values (use a tolerance).
For rank-k approximation, use only the first k columns/rows of U, S, and Vt.
